answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 24433 Country: India Title: Please give me some reference from sahih hadith or equivalent proof that Prophet Mohammed or Sahaba prayed nafil salah after zohar asr and esha prayers. Also tell dua after farz salah is right Question: Assalam Alaikum . Please give me some reference from sahih hadith or equivalent proof that Prophet Mohammed or Sahaba prayed nafil salah after zohar asr and esha prayers. Also tell dua after farz salah is right Answer ID: 24433 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1701/1701/M=1431) It is forbidden to offer nafl after Asr salah. The holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) has said: لا صلاة بعد العصر حتى تغرب الشمس و لا صلاة بعد الفجر حتى تطلع الشمس رواه الشيخان . It is proved to offer two rakah sunnah immediately after the fardh of Zuhar and Isha salah. كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي قبل الظهر أربعاً و بعدها ركعتين . رواه مسلم و أبو داؤد و ابن حنبل . It is right to supplicate after fardh salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
